name: @aexhq/user-tests
description: Layer-4 'user tests' — exercise the packed/published aex artifact in a clean install tree, the way a real user or AI agent would on day one. Product SDK/CLI access goes through a child process whose cwd is a fresh `bun install` tempdir; the harness may import local test fixtures.

scripts.test:user:fuzz: mkdir -p .tmp && rm -f .tmp/junit-test-user-fuzz.xml && bun test --isolate --timeout=300000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.tmp/junit-test-user-fuzz.xml test/live/live-api-fuzz.test.ts && node ../../scripts/cicd/assert-no-skips.mjs .tmp/junit-test-user-fuzz.xml
scripts.test:user:e2e: bun run --filter @aexhq/contracts --filter @aexhq/cli build && mkdir -p .tmp && rm -f .tmp/junit-test-user-e2e.xml && bun test --isolate --timeout=120000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.tmp/junit-test-user-e2e.xml test/e2e && node ../../scripts/cicd/assert-no-skips.mjs .tmp/junit-test-user-e2e.xml
